metadata.rules_text:
- Model consistently underestimates price spikes and overestimates declines, especially after recent highs or lows.
- Forecasts show strong mean reversion bias, pulling prices back toward prior 10-15 day averages too early, missing sustained momentum.
- Overshoots occur after sharp upward moves (e.g., 35+), leading to overcorrection and premature downward drift.
- Sentiment history is uniformly neutral (0.00), so sentiment-driven adjustments are not triggered — model should adjust for volatility clustering even without sentiment signals.
- Horizon-specific error: 30-day forecasts are too conservative in the early part of the window, then overreact to later volatility — suggest smoothing or weighting recent data more heavily.
- Avoid “flat” forecasts when recent price action shows clear trend or volatility — model should respond to momentum even without sentiment.
